evidence_class: HYPOTHESIS: prospective source custody; no split rows or model outcomes acquired
authority: neutral_benchmark_protocol.json; the same input-only connected-component grouping and deterministic allocation rules apply
preexecution_amendment: Preserve both failed timestamped attempts. The first stopped on anonymous metadata transport; the second acquired and parsed all pinned sources but found a duplicate gram-frequency index declaration before grouping/allocation completed. The shared exact prefix builder is the sole index owner. Reuse only byte-verified raw objects from the committed pre-parse custody receipt; partitions, paper grouping, annotations, allocation, rights and gates are unchanged.

source.byte_pin: Versioned object names are not cryptographic immutability. Persist actual archive and selected-member SHA-256 before parsing or allocation. Never execute bundled evaluation code or extract archive paths.
source.license_class: shipping-train: source-specific CC-BY-4.0 declaration in the pinned dataset card and loader
source.rights_scope: Local source custody under the dataset grant, preserving source/paper attribution and modification notices. No raw paper redistribution; underlying full-paper republication rights remain subject to review.
source.grouping: One paper and all its questions, answer annotations, evidence, figures/captions and versions stay together. Join canonical arXiv version IDs, normalized complete titles, exact full-document hashes and verified full-document near duplicates. Rater IDs are provenance, not independent sample units or model inputs. Never merge unrelated papers solely because they share a generic question or an annotator.
source.annotation_custody: Preserve nullable/raw yes_no, unanswerable, extractive_spans, free_form_answer and all individual annotations. Do not coerce null or an absent/non-Boolean answer to False; unanswerable is not a negative Boolean answer. Preserve evidence and highlighted_evidence separately as gold provenance, never insert them into the model state.
source.exposure: Public QASPER/LongBench/SCROLLS replication risk; no claim of universally fresh confirmation. Pinned card contains schema placeholders, not a selected study example. Exact model training membership is unknown.
source.use_now: Acquire/hash/schema-census/group and seal source partitions only. Parent output is counts, schemas, hashes and exposure metadata; no confirmation text, questions, labels or quality scores.
source.length_gate: No8192/16K coverage claim or token eligibility count in this custody step. Pin reference and evaluated-route tokenizer bytes plus substantive-text serialization before a subsequent automated length census, and perform that census before model selection. No padding or repeated text. Missing length/independent-unit coverage opens another source branch, not a terminal block.

failure_policy: Retain timestamped attempts; correct source/parser implementation errors prospectively without overwriting frozen artifacts or selecting on labels. No HTTP credentials, paid services, shipping training, evaluation or raw redistribution in this step.
